task: E2E emitted-project builds inherit the ambient CARGO_TARGET_DIR (the isolated per-lane compiler target), forcing a FRESH runtime compile (tokio/sqlx/axum, ~8GB) per lane/build — the dominant wasted compute in the burndown. Decouple in tools/oracle (build_and_run_rust / build_rust_binary): pin the EMITTED-project cargo build to the SHARED ~/.cache/sky-rust-target (runtime compiled once, reused; proven race-free via cargo build-dir lock + unique emitted package names) REGARDLESS of the ambient CARGO_TARGET_DIR — EXCEPT when the current change edits runtime/ (different vendored runtime -> must isolate). Keeps compiler-crate builds isolated (race safety) while sharing the runtime.
notes: Empirically proven safe 2026-07-14 (/tmp/skyc-share-exp: two concurrent emitted builds to the shared target, both exit 0, lock-serialized, tokio not recompiled). Documented in autopilot.sh TARGET-DIR RULE. Build-perf, not a sweep blocker. [progdev-safe] | REFINEMENT (user, 2026-07-14): the mechanism to make shared-emitted-target safe WITHOUT isolation is to PREFIX the emitted package name per consumer (e.g. 'laneB-26-ui-showcase' / 'reviewer-<id>-<example>') so two lanes building the same example become DISTINCT crates -> no same-name/different-source clobber, tokio/sqlx/hyper reused. Caveats to encode: (1) cargo whole-target build-lock serializes concurrent invocations (removes the correctness race, not a throughput win — builds queue on the lock); (2) a runtime-EDITING lane still collides on the same-named sky_runtime crate -> such lanes MUST isolate the emitted build too; (3) unique names accumulate crates in the target forever -> periodic prune needed; (4) sccache ALREADY dedups the COMPUTE across isolated targets (tokio = cache-hit), so isolation's real cost is DISK not CPU — the rename's win is reclaiming disk + dropping the override, not compile time. Compiler crates (skyc + ~20 workspace crates) CANNOT use this (same names, diff source, renaming all path-deps is infeasible) -> compiler target stays per-lane isolated. Net design = HYBRID: isolated compiler target + shared emitted target with per-consumer package-name prefix (unmodified-runtime lanes only).

task: Reused-by-value generic param clone gap (SEAL): a generic/wildcard type-param used MORE THAN ONCE in a BY-VALUE kernel call moves twice -> cargo E0382 (borrow of moved value). Root cause: clone_class(IrType::Generic(_)) => CloneClass::NonClone (sky_lower/src/lower.rs:828), so the T5 multi-use-clone pass (fires only for CloneOk) skips generic params, AND reject_fn_value_reuse is a no-op for Generic (ir_contains_fun(Generic)=false), so a reused generic silently moves twice.
